title: synthesis
description: A synthesis with Yosys (answer of 'synthesize'), or the reading of a design directory (answer of 'read_design'): the netlist, and what made it. Version 1.

design.description: The name of the design directory (read_design), or null

design_folder.description: The design directory, as a whole path

netlist.description: The netlist (.blif or .eblif): made by the synthesis, or the one of the design that is read

script.description: The script of Yosys that was written

device_package.description: The device package whose script was used, or null for the generic script

files.description: The Verilog files that are synthesized

sdc.description: The SDC of the design, given to VPR (read_design)

odc.description: The ODC file of the design (role odc), read with read_odc (read_design)

constraints.description: The script has the synthesis commands of the ODC of the session

synthesized.description: Yosys ran and made the netlist (false for a plan, a check, or a design of a netlist)

circuit_read.description: The netlist was read as the circuit
